parts.desc: 主工作目录包含 .git；所有 worktree 共享同一套历史和分支引用
parts.desc_en: The main working directory contains .git; all worktrees share the same set of history and branch references

parts.desc: 常用的工作目录，当前检出 main 分支
parts.desc_en: Commonly used working directory, currently checking out the main branch

parts.desc: 通过 worktree add 创建的额外目录，检出另一条分支
parts.desc_en: Check out another branch through the additional directory created by worktree add

variants.when: 要从 main 新开分支和工作目录时
variants.when_en: When you want to open a new branch and working directory from main

variants.when: 查看已有工作目录及其分支
variants.when_en: View the existing working directory and its branches

variants.when: 完成任务并确认无需保留目录后
variants.when_en: After completing the task and confirming that the directory does not need to be preserved

use.t: 当前任务不能中断、又要临时处理另一件事时创建 Worktree
让每个文件夹对应一条明确分支，避免内容混在一起
使用列表命令确认每个文件夹与分支的对应关系
确认改动已保存且服务已停止后，再移除 Worktree

dont.t: 只是普通切换任务也创建许多工作树，让目录越来越难管理
在两个文件夹里同时尝试打开同一条分支
未保存改动或仍有服务运行时就移除目录
直接删除文件夹；应使用 Worktree 的移除命令更新 Git 记录

lessonPractice.title: 首页分支正在运行且改到一半，现在要并行修复线上 Bug，又不想收起当前改动或切换分支。怎样做？

options.label: 为修复分支创建额外 Worktree，在另一个目录独立修改和运行
options.feedback: 同一仓库的不同分支分配到不同目录，两项任务可同时保留文件和进程现场。

options.label: 让两个 Worktree 同时打开首页分支，分别修改不同文件
options.feedback: 同一分支不能同时检出到两个 Worktree，任务也应使用职责清楚的独立分支。

options.label: 复制当前项目文件夹后直接修改，修完再手工把变化文件拷回原目录
options.feedback: 普通副本没有清楚的分支对应关系，手工回拷也容易遗漏、覆盖或混入当前未完成改动。

en.title: A homepage branch is running with unfinished changes when an urgent production fix arrives, and the current workspace must remain. What should be done?

options.label: Create another worktree for the fix branch and edit and run it in a separate directory
options.feedback: Different branches of one repository get separate directories, preserving both file and process workspaces.

options.label: Open the homepage branch in two worktrees and edit different files in each
options.feedback: One branch cannot be checked out in two worktrees, and tasks need distinct responsibility branches.

options.label: Copy the current project folder, edit it directly, and manually copy changed files back afterward
options.feedback: A plain copy lacks a clear branch mapping, and manual copying can omit, overwrite, or mix unfinished changes.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请保留当前首页 Worktree，为最新 main 上的 hotfix 分支创建独立 Worktree 和目录。分别使用不同端口运行；修复合并后先确认目录干净、服务停止，再用 Git Worktree 命令移除。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Keep the current homepage worktree and create a separate directory and hotfix branch from latest main. Run on different ports; after merge, confirm a clean directory and stopped services before removing it with Git worktree.

entry.demoDetail:
同一份 Git 历史
项目主版本继续保持运行
新功能版本在另一个文件夹修改
git worktree add 新文件夹 新分支

Worktree 让同一个 Git 项目同时出现在两个文件夹里，每个文件夹打开不同分支。它适合不想中断当前工作、又要临时处理另一件事。
scenes: git worktree add 创建目录
AI 两个窗口并行修改
list 查看与 remove 清理

en.demoDetail:
The same Git history
Project master versionKeep running
New feature versionModified in another folder
git worktree add new folder new branch

Worktree allows the same Git project to appear in two folders at the same time, and each folder opens a different branch. It is suitable for people who do not want to interrupt their current work but need to deal with another thing temporarily.

use.t: Handle an urgent fix without closing current work
Compare two branches side by side
Run separate builds from the same repository
Keep a long-running task open while reviewing another branch

dont.t: Create worktrees without tracking where they live
Edit the same generated output from several worktrees
Delete the directory manually and leave stale metadata
Use worktrees when simply switching a clean branch is enough
